summary.text: Kim McLaughlin is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Robert Farnsworth (R).
She is a business manager for the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities system and a member of the Hibbing School Board.

paragraphs.text: On her campaign website, Kim McLaughlin describes herself as a Chisholm native and a graduate of Chisholm High School, with degrees from Hibbing Community College and the University of Minnesota Duluth.

She says she is a Certified Public Accountant and Certified Fraud Examiner who spent 18 years as an internal auditor in the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities system and now works there as a business manager.

She says she has served on the Hibbing School Board for a decade and currently serves as its Chair Pro-Tem and Treasurer, and that she also sits on the Range Association of Municipalities and Schools board and the Arrowhead Regional Development Commission.
McLaughlin sought the Democratic nomination for Minnesota State Senate District 7 in 2022 and lost the August 9 primary to Ben DeNucci.
She was also listed on the November 2022 general election ballot, in which Robert Farnsworth won.
